leadText: Pikachu Liberal Arts Department (Japanese: ) is a group that has been responsible for writing lyrics for Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire.
plainText:
Pikachu Liberal Arts Department (Japanese: ) is a group that has been responsible for writing lyrics for Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire.

==Songs==
Pikachu Liberal Arts Department has written the lyrics of the following songs:
Full of Summer!!
GLORY DAY ~That Shining Day~
